method: Every store the catalogue's buy links open (src/lib/programmes.ts linkStore) and every store in data/sellers. A network is given only where the network's own public programme page or the store's own affiliate page says so, opened on 13 Nov 2026 through a summarising fetch tool unless the note says the page could not be opened (then the claim rests on the page's title in a web search, and says so). Third-party directories (affi.io, affilitizer, linkclicky) are never a source. A FlexOffers listing is FlexOffers' own page, but FlexOffers relays many programmes it doesn't run, so those say so. No account was signed into; commission and cookie terms change, so check the network before joining. 'unknown' means no such page was found or looked for, not that there is no programme.

walmart.note: "Walmart.com uses Impact Radius as our Affiliate Service Provider." walmart.ca is a separate programme (walmart-ca in affiliate-programs.ts, Rakuten, not confirmed here). Terms ban price-alert features for Walmart products.

terms.quote: Section 3(a), General Prohibitions: you may not use "price tracking and/or price alerting functionality relating to products sold on the Sites". Section 8 also allows prices only as Walmart supplies them, and section 13 wants them updated within 24 hours of a change.

tesco.note: FlexOffers lists Tesco Stores (1.6% marketplace and F&F, 3.2% new customers, 30-day cookie) but shows no programme status or country. affiliate-programs.ts still files Tesco under CJ, unconfirmed: set AFF_TESCO to the full FlexOffers link template once approved.

aponeo.note: APONEO DE, Awin 15521: 1% of net merchandise value, 30-day cookie.

mytime.note: myTime DE, Awin 14902: 7% new customers, 2% existing, 60-day cookie.

zooplus.note: One Awin programme per shop: zooplus DE 11330 (3% first three orders, then 1%, 30 days), zooplus IE 33309 (https://ui.awin.com/merchant-profile/33309: 6% first order, 2% after, 30 days), zooplus.co.uk 2940. zooplus's own affiliate page (https://www.zooplus.co.uk/info/about/affiliate_programme) offers daily CSV product data with deep links.

amazon.note: Amazon Associates runs its own programme per storefront (affiliate-program.amazon.co.uk for the UK). Closes an account without 3 sales in 180 days.

aldi.note: No programme page found for Aldi UK, Aldi Nord, Aldi Süd or Aldi US.

netto.note: Netto Marken-Discount DE (netto-online.de), Awin 13812: 4% standard sales, 60-day cookie. Links to netto.de (the Danish-owned Netto stores) are not covered.

rewe.note: REWE has a partner programme page (https://www.rewe.de/partnerprogramm/), but it could not be opened from here, so its network isn't confirmed.

target.note: Target Partners is Target's own programme; its pages need JavaScript and couldn't be read here, so Impact as the platform is from affiliate-programs.ts, not confirmed today.

lidl.note: Lidl's own page: the programme runs on Awin, up to 5% per online-shop order. Covers lidl.de only; no Lidl GB programme found. affiliate-programs.ts files it as a template; with AWIN_PUBLISHER_ID set, AFF_LIDL_DE takes the Awin merchant ID once known.
